description: "Hodge and His Masters" by Richard Jefferies is a collection of essays written during the late 19th century, reflecting on agricultural life and the various characters inhabiting the rural landscape. The work delves into the complexities and struggles faced by farmers and laborers, examining the social and economic dynamics of their lives, particularly during a time of agricultural depression.
